subject: Single-rollup invoice feed + email bridge for SEPA / VAT evidence
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwood.com>
To: GlobeTech AP <accounts@globetech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Dec 2029 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Proposal: single-rollup SFTP feed + email copy bridge for first two cycles

Hi Priya / AP team,

Following up from our vendor onboarding call — we want to propose a single consolidated invoice feed that posts a monthly rollup to your SFTP (one file per accounting period) and, for the first two billing cycles, also send an automated PDF copy to accounts@globetech.com so your AP team has the immediate records while final mappings are validated.

Key items we plan to support:
- Single-rollup CSV/XML per month containing per-entity line-items (remit_to, PO, invoice_number, net/gross, tax_code).
- Per-invoice VAT evidence as separate PDF (attached in the sample) with standardized filename: invoice_<invoice_number>_vat.pdf.
- Tokenized invoice IDs (prefix REDW-) to avoid collisions across entities.
- SEPA-friendly fields (IBAN, Creditor ID) included in the remittance section.

Questions for you:
1) Can you confirm the inbound SFTP host/path and preferred auth (SSH key or username/password)?
2) Any mandatory PO mapping rules (e.g., PO must be first 10 chars of the PO field)?
3) Will you accept the VAT evidence as separate PDF per invoice, or do you prefer an embedded attachment in a single XML bundle?

We can start a staged rollout: week 0—SFTP+email bridge, week 4—remove email copies once mappings are stable. If you need a longer overlap we can extend.

I attached a sample PDF and our XML schema for your integrations team.

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
From: GlobeTech AP <accounts@globetech.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@globetech.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Dec 2029 10:25:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposal: single-rollup SFTP feed + email copy bridge for first two cycles

Hi Lukas — thanks for the clear summary. A few notes from our side: 

- SFTP: we can provision an inbound account. Host: invoices.globetech.com, path /inbound/redwood/. We require SSH key auth; drop the public key to sftp-admin@globetech.com.
- PO mapping: our AP system matches on exact PO fields; please include a CSV column named PO_NUMBER and ensure the PO value is the full PO (no truncation).
- VAT evidence: we prefer a separate PDF per invoice named exactly as you suggested. We will not accept embedded evidence at the line-item level in the XML for automated ingestion.
- SEPA/IBAN: we require Creditor ID on the invoice and a separate field for IBAN in the remittance block.

Two items to flag:
1) For reverse-charge scenarios (EU customers), we need a VAT tag per line item and an explicit "Reverse Charge" text on the PDF.
2) Our legal team requires a signed commercial invoice only for invoices over EUR 25k — otherwise a standard PDF is fine.

We'll have SFTP creds ready if you send the SSH public key to sftp-admin@globetech.com.

Best,
Priya Menon
Senior AP Manager, GlobeTech Solutions

> Following up from our vendor onboarding call — we want to propose a single consolidated invoice feed...

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Dec 2029 08:41:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposal: single-rollup SFTP feed + email copy bridge for first two cycles

Thanks, Priya — this is perfect and very actionable. Quick responses inline then an ops plan below.

- SSH key: Connor, can you generate a dedicated keypair for GlobeTech and forward the public key to sftp-admin@globetech.com? We should namespace it redwood_globetech_2029.pub.
- PO mapping: we'll add PO_NUMBER as a required CSV column (full value, no truncation).
- VAT evidence: we'll emit invoice_<invoice_number>_vat.pdf next to the rollup (same folder) for the first two cycles; file naming will be deterministic so your matcher can pick it up.
- SEPA: include CREDITOR_ID and IBAN columns in the remittance block and place Creditor ID in the PDF header.

Ops rollout proposal (proposed by Redwood):
Week -1: Connor sends SSH pubkey; GlobeTech confirms path and test credentials.
Week 0: Send test rollup (test flags, non-financial) to /inbound/redwood/ and a copy to accounts@globetech.com; GlobeTech to validate mappings.
Week 1: Send first live rollup; keep email bridge active.
Week 4: Remove email bridge if reconciliation is clean; otherwise extend to Week 8.

Attachments included: redwood-invoice-xml-schema-v2.xml (sample file layout), vat-evidence-template.pdf, sample-invoice-20291130.pdf (signed commercial invoice example).

Connor: can you confirm the key will be ready by end of day? Kimberly/Hannah — can you prepare a short runbook for our billing ops (how we tokenized invoice IDs, where the VAT PDFs live, and the fallback email template we will use)? I want the runbook in our onboarding folder before the test send.

Thanks — Lukas

Cc: Priya Menon <priya@globetech.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@globetech.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Dec 2029 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposal: single-rollup SFTP feed + email copy bridge for first two cycles

All — acknowledging and confirming the plan from billing ops side. A few operational details from our checklist: 

1) Runbook: I'll prepare the runbook (location: Drive > Onboarding > GlobeTech > billing-runbook.md) and include: filename patterns, tokenization rule (REDW-YYYYMM-nnn), error codes for failed ingestion, and sample reconciliation query.
2) Fallback email: if SFTP transfer fails, we will send invoices to accounts@globetech.com with subject: "Redwood Invoice COPY <invoice_number> - TEST/PROD" and attach the corresponding VAT PDF. 
3) SEPA verification: Priya — before we go live can you share a sample IBAN for validation? We will run a checksum on the IBAN and report mismatches back to the AP mailbox.
4) Legal: Hannah, looping you for the signed-commercial-invoice threshold. We will tag any invoice > EUR 25k in the rollup and attach the signed PDF.

Timeline: Kimberly will own the runbook and initial test send on Week 0. Connor will confirm SSH key & SFTP test by EOD. Lukas to coordinate the HubSpot deal stage to "SFTP Onboard" once test passes.

Thanks — Kim
